top_band: gold horizontal top surface at rows 1-3 with dark brown back edge at row 0 and pale cream front-edge highlight at row 4
evidence: Reading down the middle column: row 0 is the dark brown back edge, rows 1-3 are a 3px gold top surface, and row 4 is a 1px pale cream front-edge highlight (4-5 rows total for the top band). Directly below row 4 is a 2px dark brown eave shadow (rows 5-6), followed by the vertical red front face with framed reels and recessed coin/payout slots (rows 7-26) and a gold/brown base (rows 27-31).

style.evidence: While the outlines use dark material tones (dark brown next to gold, dark maroon next to red), almost every surface is filled with a single unshaded flat colour: the 10x3 gold top (rows 1-3), the entire red cabinet face (rows 7-26, which has only 1 flat red tone plus its dark outline), the blocky reel bands, and the 10x2 and 12x3 base bands (rows 27-31) lack surface grain, specular shading, and texture compared to the Beodeul stall and well references.
